name: Velvet Antenna v0.20.4 Standalone
author: James
description: Standalone Velvet Antenna release. v0.20.4 fixes duplicate filtering so unresolved cards cannot leak into duplicate results, requires corroborating title evidence for provider-ID matches, and retains Needs ID, native multi-select, playback, Series/Season and metadata-management functionality.

name: Velvet Antenna v0.21.5 Velvet Lens
author: James
description: Standalone Velvet Antenna redesign focused on speed and a distinct browsing identity. v0.21.5 restores Jellyfin's native right-click and multi-select administration by keeping context-menu handling untouched and raising the native selection command bar above Velvet Antenna navigation, while retaining inline IDENTIFY, duplicate resolution badges and DELETE, native Series/Season functionality, subtitles and detail PLAY/CONTINUE.

name: Velvet Antenna v0.22.12 CC+ Fixed Overlay Hotfix
author: James
description: Small compatibility hotfix for Antenna Flow. v0.22.12 anchors CC+ as a fixed, top-layer playback overlay near the player controls, hides the older in-player CC+ launcher, and keeps subtitle search available even when Jellyfin hides its native CC selector because no local subtitle tracks exist.

name: Velvet Antenna v0.22.13 Antenna Flow
author: James
description: Series Integrity Audit release. v0.22.13 adds an AUDIT SERIES workflow that compares each TMDb-identified Jellyfin Series against its canonical TMDb season structure through Velvet Antenna Bridge 0.2.0.0, then drills into only incomplete seasons to identify exact aired episodes that are missing. Entire missing seasons, individual missing episodes, unverifiable Series and complete Series are reported separately. Unaired episodes are excluded, Specials/Season 0 are optional, Jellyfin virtual missing-episode placeholders do not count as owned files, and combined episode files using IndexNumberEnd are treated as covering their full episode range. Per-Series card editing, source-aware Collections, curated artwork, player EXIT, first-paint Home, Tonight and CC+ subtitle search remain included. The separate CC+ fixed-overlay hotfix has been withdrawn because its global DOM observer could destabilise playback.
